The '''1934–35 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by three points over city rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]] and [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1935–36 Scottish Division Two]].
